items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Fixes exactly the reported defect (missing encoding= on _git's subprocess.run) and audits+fixes the same pattern in the two other subprocess.run sites reachable from publish_release_notes.py's call chain (create_github_release._run, repo_identity.resolve_repo_identity); nothing beyond that scope was touched.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: No boundary contract changed; the existing OSError/TimeoutExpired try/except around each subprocess.run call is untouched, only the decode behavior changed.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input reaches SQL/HTML; no secrets added; version-string argv validation elsewhere is unaffected by this change.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Three new regression tests spawn a real child process emitting a byte undecodable in cp1252 and assert on the outcome (stdout is not None / no crash) rather than internals; each was verified to fail against the pre-fix code (git stash) and pass after.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No loops, queries, or pagination involved.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Mirrors the established encoding="utf-8", errors="replace" pattern from commit ce65a88f (pr_blockers.py, watch_pr_delivery.py); all touched files stay well under 300 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format changed — this is a subprocess text-decode fix, not a producer/consumer format change.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: uv run shared/scripts/tools/scan_test_hygiene.py --diff reported no findings.
